name: Invisible text instruction
description: Instructions hidden using CSS to make text invisible to humans but readable by agents. Any of the hiding styles is flagged wherever it appears, with one structural exception that keys on the tag name alone: a frame or a script tag closed at once, or an image, input, link, meta, source, track, embed, line break or rule tag, none of which holds text. What the attributes say is never read, except that a frame with a srcdoc is flagged. Any other hidden element is flagged, including hidden interface text such as a closed cookie dialog.
